whatItIs.statement: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.

whenToUse.statement: Use Toggle Group when related toggle actions belong together and the user may select either one item or multiple items.

howToUse.statement: Set type="single" for one selected value or type="multiple" for an array of selected values.
Give every ToggleGroupItem a unique non-empty value and provide an accessible name for icon-only items.

options.statement: Use spacing={0} for connected items; the default spacing is 2.
Use orientation="vertical" for a vertical group; variant and size are inherited by items from the group.
